question.text: In case of a Category III AIF with a breach of its permitted leverage limits, by when must the custodian report the breach to SEBI?

answer.text: Within the same working day of breach
Before 10:00 AM on the next working day
Within 30 days of breach through the merchant banker

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 13.7.2, in case of a Category III AIF with a breach of its permitted leverage limits, the custodian shall report to SEBI the name of the fund, the extent of the breach, and the reasons for the breach before 10:00 AM on the next working day. The Trap: Same-working-day is not the prescribed window; 7 calendar days and 30 days via Merchant Banker are both too lax for a leverage breach. The 10:00 AM next-working-day cut-off is specific and time-of-day-stamped. Note: Three elements travel together — reporting party (custodian), report contents (name, extent, reasons), and timing (before 10:00 AM next working day).
